sources.snippet: GPT-OSS-20B represents the first open-weight 20.9B parameter MoE model, making it an ideal candidate for comprehensive deployment analysis on a single-GPU (H100, bf16) setup. Understanding its deployment characteristics compared to dense models is crucial for practitioners making architectural decisions in production environments.
